paper_title: PyramidInfer Pyramid KV Cache Compression for High-throughput LLM   Inference
caption: The perplexity standard deviations when only PvCs are reserved at each layer.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the perplexity standard deviations when only PvCs are reserved at each layer. The x-axis is labeled "Layer", has a linear scale, ranges from 0 to 30 (though data points extend to 37, the visible range is 0 to 37), and has tick labels at intervals of 10. The y-axis is labeled "Perplexity (log) Std", has a linear scale, ranges from 0.00 to 1.75, and has tick labels at intervals of 0.25. A single line is shown in orange with diamond markers and a solid line style, starting at approximately 1.80 on the y-axis at x=0, decreasing sharply to around 0.30 by x=2, and continuing to decrease more gradually to nearly 0.00 by x=20, remaining relatively stable at this low value until x=37.
